name: 瑞士字体机 · Swiss Typographic Machine
description: RepoChan's own Swiss-International landing page: a type-driven industrial document where the mascot is deliberately demoted to a cameo — masthead mini icon, a hero Fig. 01 with the complete-in-frame cutout B under a 1px rule caption, numbered thesis / pipeline spec / artifact index tables, real dogfood evidence figures (foundation sheet + studio poster), a mono-command CTA and a ≤120px footer cutout. zh default locale with a full en edition; every bitmap is real pipeline output.

assets.description: Complete-in-frame die-cut cutout B (forward lunge, open-palm reach) — the hero's Fig. 01 with a 1px-rule mono caption, the page's only large character visual. Transparent webp produced by chroma-key + compress. Reference is the raw matte master (1:1, complete-in-frame doctrine: no edge cropping).

brief.intent: Regenerate the hero Fig. 01 cutout for the downstream project's character: a welcoming forward-leaning pose with an open palm reaching toward the viewer, complete-in-frame so it can sit in a Swiss figure block with a rule caption.
mustInclude: one full-body character leaning forward with an open-palm reach, fully inside the canvas
perfectly flat uniform matte background in a color absent from the character
square 1:1 framing, character centered, all limbs/hair/props complete with margin on every edge

assets.description: Footer cameo cutout (same cutout-B master as the hero Fig. 01, waving read) — displayed at ≤120px in the colophon as the mascot's only other appearance. Transparent webp produced by chroma-key + compress. Reference is the raw matte master (1:1, complete-in-frame).

brief.intent: Regenerate the footer-cameo cutout for the downstream project's character: a small friendly waving/presenting pose that still reads at ≤120px in a page colophon.
mustInclude: one full-body character waving or presenting, fully inside the canvas
perfectly flat uniform matte background in a color absent from the character
square 1:1 framing, character centered, readable at favicon-adjacent sizes

assets.description: Project icon — masthead 28px badge; also the favicon source (favicon.ico / apple-touch-icon.png / icon-192.png / icon-512.png are derived from it offline via compress + favicon + resize).

mustInclude: one scalable brand mark reading cleanly at 28px in a masthead
creativeFreedom: accent colors from the project palette

assets.description: Character foundation sheet — Evidence Fig. A, shown as a real dogfood artifact with a rule caption (key visual, expressions, palette, props), served as JPEG q85. Reference is the raw generated master (1:1); also the page's og:image.

brief.intent: Regenerate the downstream project character's foundation sheet — the consistency baseline every other order references — so the Evidence section can show it as a real traceable artifact.
mustInclude: one foundation sheet for the project character: key visual, expression set, color palette and key props
square 1:1 framing with every panel fully inside the canvas
avoid: panels cropped by the canvas edge
creativeFreedom: expression and prop selection within the persona

assets.description: Studio scene poster — Evidence Fig. B, the character's world scene shown as a real dogfood artifact with a rule caption; 3:2 landscape, served as JPEG q82.

brief.intent: Repaint the studio scene poster for the downstream project: the project character at work in its world (e.g. drawing at a pen display), a landscape scene that reads as evidence of the brand world rather than decoration.
mustInclude: the project character integrated into a coherent workspace/world scene
landscape 3:2 framing that crops cleanly at evidence-figure sizes
creativeFreedom: scene props and lighting within the project identity
